title: Android 1.0.7 build 9 copied to Zakaria and verified
summary: Built the replacement signed release APK and copied it to the connected phone?s Zakaria folder. Local and phone SHA-256 hashes match.

changes.detail: Aligned native Android version 1.0.7, versionCode 9 and Expo runtime 1.0.7 with app.json.
Created the signed APK and copied 146124626 bytes to /sdcard/Zakaria/lecomax-learn-1.0.7-build9.apk.

validation.name: Release build
validation.detail: Gradle assembleRelease completed successfully in 1m 24s on the final incremental attempt. Earlier attempts encountered missing staged dependency files, stale original-path build caches (cancelled and cleared), and a packaging failure after a metaspace warning; final retry passed.

validation.name: APK identity and signature
validation.detail: aapt confirmed com.lecomax.learning versionName 1.0.7, versionCode 9, arm64-v8a and x86_64. apksigner verified APK Signature Scheme v2.

validation.name: Phone transfer integrity
validation.detail: ADB push succeeded. Local and device SHA-256: 74f876765c3212c6bda8176db3aa1df748599b4c7a5893b4f1df74cbda0612ae. Phone file size equals local size: 146124626 bytes.

validation.name: Typecheck, focused lint and history tests
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck passed; ESLint passed for components/ChangeHistory.tsx and app/change-history.tsx; all six change-history unit and interaction tests passed.

validation.name: Installation and device runtime
validation.detail: The APK was copied only; installation, launch and runtime behavior were not tested. This verification report was appended after building and is available in source/current app history; the delivered APK bundles the preceding needs-testing report. No deployment performed.
